job.title: Senior Java Developer - E-Commerce + Accounting & Marketplaces - remote in EU

tailoring.headline: Senior Java Developer | Spring Boot, REST APIs & Microservices | E-Commerce Platforms
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring and Spring Boot, RESTful APIs, microservices, SQL and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of data and API integrations between PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Hands-on with CI/CD pipelines, cloud deployments, Docker and Kubernetes, production troubleshooting, Git, code reviews and agile teams. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

cover_en.subject: Application: Senior Java Developer - E-Commerce + Accounting & Marketplaces
cover_en.hook: I am very interested in contributing my expertise to pathway solutions gmbh as a Senior Java Developer. With over 5 years of professional backend and e-commerce experience building enterprise systems at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring strong technical capabilities in Java, Spring, and RESTful APIs.

bullets.label: Backend & E-Commerce Development
bullets.text: Designed and implemented backend functionality on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) using Java and Spring, covering product, catalog, pricing and customer data management.

bullets.label: REST APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC REST Web Services (headless APIs) for storefront and third-party consumers, alongside PIM-to-Hybris data pipelines using Profisee, Hotfolders and DataHub.

bullets.label: Database & Query Optimization
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring that reduced response latency and improved transaction speed, utilizing strong SQL and performance tuning skills.

bullets.label: CI/CD & Cloud Workflows
bullets.text: Executed CI/CD deployment cycles and release builds on SAP Commerce Cloud (CCv2) within agile DevOps workflows, utilizing Docker and Kubernetes.

cover_en.gap: While my background heavily focuses on enterprise e-commerce platforms, Java, and REST APIs rather than dedicated accounting modules, I am keen to learn these domain specifics quickly.
cover_en.logistics: I am based in Karlsruhe, Germany, and hold a valid residence and work permit requiring no sponsorship. I am currently serving a notice period with my last working day on 15 December 2026, and I am available to start on 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience aligns with your team.

tailoring.why_company: I want to work at pathway solutions gmbh because of your focus on innovative e-commerce solutions and technical excellence. My strong background in Java, Spring Boot, and enterprise e-commerce platforms aligns directly with your technical stack, and I am eager to bring my 5+ years of experience in building scalable REST APIs and handling complex backend integrations to your remote engineering team.
tailoring.motivation_short: I bring 5+ years of Java and e-commerce platform experience, strong backend integration skills, and a commitment to robust, scalable code in agile environments.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I saw your opening for a Senior Java Developer and wanted to connect. With 5+ years building e-commerce backends, Java, Spring Boot, and REST APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am very interested in pathway solutions gmbh. Let's connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Senior Java Developer - Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Senior Java Developer position. With over 5 years of experience developing enterprise e-commerce platforms, Java, Spring, and RESTful APIs at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am well-equipped to contribute to your team.

I hold a valid German work permit and am available starting December 16, 2026. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
